nodes.name: Lemma A.1, Lemma A.2: $\boldsymbol{\min}$
nodes.statement:
Let $E$ be a binary relation on $\mathbb{Q}^k$ that is preserved by $\min$.
    If $E$ is smooth, then  $E$ contains a min-clean tuple.

Let $n \geq 2$, and  let $R$ be an $n$-ary relation on $\mathbb{Q}^k$ that is preserved by $\min$. If $R$ is cyclic, then $R$ contains a loop.

nodes.name: Lemma 4.10, Lemma 4.12: $\boldsymbol{\mathrm{mi}}$
nodes.statement:
Let $E$ be a binary relation on $\mathbb{Q}^k$ that is preserved by $\langle\mathrm{mi}\rangle$.  
     If $E$ is smooth and has pseudo-algebraic length $1$, 
     
     then $E$ contains a min-clean tuple.

Let $n\geq 3$, and let $R$ be an $n$-ary  relation  on $\mathbb{Q}^k$ that is 
 preserved by $\langle\mathrm\rangle{mi}$. If $R$ is cyclic and $2$-transitive, then $R$ contains a min-clean tuple.

nodes.name: Lemma A.4, Lemma A.5: $\boldsymbol{\mathrm{mx}}$
nodes.statement:
Let $E$ be a binary relation on $\mathbb{Q}^k$ that is  preserved by $\langle\mathrm{mx}\rangle$. If $E$ is smooth and of pseudo-algebraic length~$1$,      then $E$ contains a min-clean tuple.

Let $n\geq 3$, and let $R$ be an $n$-ary  relation on $\mathbb{Q}^k$ that is  preserved by $\langle\mathrm\rangle{mx}$. If $R$ is  cyclic, then $R$ contains a min-clean tuple.

nodes.name: Lemma A.8, Lemma A.10: $\boldsymbol{\mathrm{lex}}$
nodes.statement:
Let $S$ be a binary relation on $\mathbb{Q}^k$. If $S$ is smooth, weakly connected, and of pseudo-algebraic length $1$, then $S'$  contains a min-clean tuple.

Let $n \geq 3$, and let $R$ be an $n$-ary relation on $\mathbb{Q}^k$ that is preserved by $\langle\mathrm\rangle{lex}$. If $R$ is cyclic and $2$-transitive,  then $R'\subseteq R$ contains a min-clean tuple.
